sources.title: Management Information Systems (MIS) Bachelor of Science Degree
sources.author: Rochester Institute of Technology
sources.content: RIT describes management information systems as the connection among technology, people, and processes that supports and improves business operations. The program emphasizes analyzing existing business processes, designing usable and cost-effective information systems, working with databases and enterprise systems, and using data visualization and analysis to generate managerial insight. Student teams apply project-management techniques to real business situations while developing information systems.
